reasons.detail: R1 — `MAX_LOOP_CALLS` is changed from 50 to 16 in `src/flow/commands/review.js`.
R2 — `createLoopReviewChunks` batches `groups` when count exceeds limit using `ceil(groups.length / maxCalls)`, yielding at most `MAX_LOOP_CALLS` chunks and thus at most that many chunk review calls.
R3 — `runLoopReviewWithDependencies` only triggers cross-check when `summaries.length > 1`, i.e., proposals were produced from more than one reviewed chunk.
R4 — Cross-check is gated by `summaries.length > 1`, so it does not run when proposals come from exactly one reviewed chunk.
R5 — Chunk inputs are hashed (`hashLoopReviewInput`) and looked up in `seen`; repeated hashes reuse cached result without calling `reviewChunk` again.
R6 — Loop review findings are converted into existing impl-review JSON shape via `loopProposalsToImplReviewJson` and then passed to existing `runImplReview` persistence path.

R7 — `runReview` now routes through `runReviewWithDependencies`/`runActiveImplReviewWithDependencies`, selecting loop review when the loop gate is true and persisting via the same impl-review writer before files are written.
